EFW_Theo.name: Theo
EFW_Theo.role: Modern memory-bearer; ancient junior attaché to General Mero
EFW_Theo.visualAnchor: Young adult man with messy dark brown hair, pale-to-light skin, lean build, tired observant eyes, practical worn dark layers rather than a uniform. Present-day visual language is tactile and human: rumpled clothing, workwear, sketchbook/research materials, no heroic polish.
continuityLocks: Keep Theo recognizably the same young man across all present-day pages.
Do not age him up, broaden his build, clean up his hair, or turn him into a conventional action hero.
Maintain the contrast between his ordinary contemporary appearance and the mythic scale of the memories he experiences.

EFW_Rae.name: Rae
EFW_Rae.role: Modern memory-bearer; ancient strategic aide to Arbiter
EFW_Rae.visualAnchor: Young adult woman with dark asymmetric undercut hair, one side closely shaved and the longer side falling loose; light-to-medium skin with freckles, sharp expressive eyes, multiple ear piercings, visible geometric/linework tattoos on forearms, lean practical build, worn black or charcoal clothing. Her look is skeptical, investigative and grounded rather than glamorous.
continuityLocks: Preserve the asymmetric undercut, freckles, piercings and visible tattoo language.
Do not soften Rae into a generic elegant sci-fi heroine or change her into formal ceremonial styling in the present-day timeline.
Keep her acting physically grounded and observant even in visually spectacular scenes.

EFW_Adrian.name: Adrian
EFW_Adrian.role: Neutral envoy, antiquarian and surviving memory of the war
EFW_Adrian.visualAnchor: Older adult man with shoulder-length silver-gray hair, weathered face, short gray beard/stubble, lean build, calm guarded eyes, dark worn contemporary clothing with understated quality. He should look like the same person in both eras, with age and bearing carrying continuity rather than costume spectacle.
continuityLocks: Keep Adrian's silver-gray hair length, lean build and weathered face stable.
Do not turn him into a robed wizard, king or overtly mystical elder in the present timeline.
His authority should come from stillness, recognition and restraint rather than visual ornament.

EFW_Vark.name: Vark
EFW_Vark.visualAnchor: Older Black man, sturdy working build, deeply weathered face, short dark hair with some gray, practical excavation gear and battered helmet/headlamp. He reads immediately as a long-serving field foreman rather than security or military personnel.
continuityLocks: Keep Vark older than Theo and physically grounded as an experienced worker.
Preserve the same practical workwear, helmet/headlamp language and weathered facial structure through the Olyria sequence.
Do not redesign him as military, ceremonial or futuristic-polished personnel.

EFW_Caelum.name: Caelum
EFW_Caelum.visualAnchor: Adult man with dark hair, trimmed beard/stubble, controlled formal appearance and pale structured Zenith institutional clothing. He should contrast Rae's worn dark practicality: ordered, clean, symmetrical, institutionally polished without looking villain-costumed.
continuityLocks: Keep Caelum visually consistent as a formal Zenith authority figure.
Preserve the light structured institutional clothing and controlled grooming.
Do not exaggerate him into a sinister fantasy official; his threat is institutional familiarity and restraint.

EFW_Starbreaker.name: Starbreaker
EFW_Starbreaker.visualAnchor: Godlike Vanguard champion with pale blond hair, luminous white-and-gold fractured armor over a dark underlayer, radiant stellar geometry concentrated at the chest and around the body, and a weapon formed from compressed first-light energy. His silhouette is sharp, crystalline and ruptured rather than knightly or medieval. He is physically human and visibly exhausted beneath the cosmic scale.
continuityLocks: Preserve the white-gold-black palette, fractured crystalline armor language and stellar chest motif.
Keep him a person inside the iconography: fatigue, anger and commitment must remain readable.
Do not drift toward generic blond fantasy paladin, angel, king or medieval knight design.

EFW_Atlas.name: Atlas
EFW_Atlas.visualAnchor: Massive dark-skinned Vanguard champion with monumental physique, deep blue-black armor or layered battle garments traced by restrained gold gravity geometry. His design evokes mass, orbit and planetary weight rather than brute fantasy armor; small suspended spheres or orbital cues may appear when dramatically useful.
continuityLocks: Maintain Atlas as the physically largest and heaviest-presence champion.
Preserve deep blue-black and gold gravity/orbital language.
Avoid generic barbarian, stone giant or armored bodybuilder treatment.

EFW_Flux.name: Flux
EFW_Flux.visualAnchor: Slender and androgynous-to-feminine Vanguard champion with dark hair, black-violet layered clothing/armor and a visual field of fractured probability: doubled edges, offset silhouettes, prismatic violet seams and spatial discontinuities. The body remains readable even when possibility effects multiply around it.
continuityLocks: Preserve black-violet probability language and slender silhouette.
Use controlled duplication/offset effects rather than generic purple magic.
Do not obscure the face and body so completely that character acting disappears.

EFW_Afterlight.name: Afterlight
EFW_Afterlight.visualAnchor: Luminous pale-haired Vanguard champion whose design combines white, gold and living restoration motifs: seed-like geometry, translucent layers, delicate botanical structures and controlled radiance. She should feel regenerative and materially alive, not angelic or priestly.
continuityLocks: Preserve seed/restoration motifs and luminous white-gold living-material language.
Keep her distinct from Starbreaker's fractured weaponized light.
Avoid generic angel, elf queen or nature goddess styling.

EFW_Mero.name: General Mero
EFW_Mero.role: Human Vanguard general among cosmic champions
EFW_Mero.visualAnchor: Older human military strategist with gray hair and beard, scarred/weathered face, practical dark command armor or uniform, compact human-scale silhouette beside the champions. His design should communicate command experience without turning him into another godlike figure.
continuityLocks: Keep Mero visibly human-scale among the champions.
Preserve practical military structure and weathered age.
Avoid oversized cosmic effects, ceremonial crowns or divine armor.

EFW_Oryon.name: Oryon
EFW_Oryon.visualAnchor: Lean, severe Concordant strategist in pale structured layers over dark formal underclothes, surrounded when useful by precise predictive diagrams, orbital lattices and cool geometric interfaces. His power language is foresight, systems and control—not sorcery.
continuityLocks: Preserve pale structured clothing and precise predictive geometry.
Keep him visually analytical and controlled rather than mystical.
Avoid generic mage, priest or royal court styling.

EFW_Regent.name: Regent
EFW_Regent.visualAnchor: Older Concordant stabilizer with severe symmetrical black formal armor/robes, restrained gold boundary geometry and a circular stabilizing halo or field when power is active. His silhouette is architectural, balanced and immovable.
continuityLocks: Preserve strict symmetry, black-gold palette and circular boundary/stability language.
Keep Regent distinct from Oryon's predictive diagrams and Arbiter's judicial severity.
Avoid generic king, emperor or dark wizard cues.

EFW_Arbiter.name: Arbiter
EFW_Arbiter.role: Concordant authority over civilization-scale triage and enforcement
EFW_Arbiter.visualAnchor: Imposing female Concordant authority in pale and dark judicial armor with sharp vertical crown-like structures integrated into the silhouette, severe geometric plating and restrained gold accents. Her presence evokes a living tribunal and irreversible judgment rather than royalty.
continuityLocks: Preserve the severe judicial silhouette, integrated vertical head structure and pale/dark/gold palette.
Keep her visually distinct from Afterlight's organic restoration language.
Avoid generic fantasy queen, angel or priestess treatment.

EFW_Redlin.name: Redlin
EFW_Redlin.role: Concordant battlefield commander and containment enforcer
EFW_Redlin.visualAnchor: Concordant battlefield commander built around containment: dark charcoal-to-black armor with deep red structural channels, circular/spherical joint and harness motifs, dense protective layers and a grounded battle-worn silhouette. Redlin should feel designed to absorb, restrain and hold rather than to radiate destructive power.
continuityLocks: Preserve dark armor, bright/deep red containment channels and circular joint/harness language.
Keep the silhouette heavier and more enclosed than Starbreaker's fractured open radiance.
Avoid generic demonic, villainous or red-black fantasy armor.

EFW_Kyn.name: Kyn
EFW_Kyn.visualAnchor: Distinctly non-Jesus-like Concordant empath with cool gray-blue skin, white/silver hair, elegant but unfamiliar facial geometry, white-teal-gold layered clothing and organic branching or neural motifs. Kyn's design communicates openness, sensory burden and connection without religious messiah imagery.
continuityLocks: Preserve gray-blue skin, white/silver hair and white-teal-gold organic/neural language.
Do not depict Kyn as a bearded long-haired human male, messiah figure, monk or Jesus analogue.
Keep empathy visually specific and embodied rather than represented by generic holiness.
